annotation.title_clean: Kenya Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies Policy
annotation.title_en: Kenya Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Department for ICT and the Digital Economy, Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, Kenya
annotation.venue: State Department for ICT and the Digital Economy
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Kenya's 2026 national policy framework for governing AI and other emerging technologies. It sets goals, guiding principles, a risk-based lifecycle approach, and policy statements with strategies, KPIs, costs and responsible institutions. It covers data governance, infrastructure, skills, research and innovation. It has no robot-specific provisions in the visible text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Endorses a risk-based, lifecycle approach to AI governance with proportionate regulation
Builds on the Kenya AI Strategy 2025–2030, Digital Master Plan 2022–2032 and Data Protection Act 2019
Policy statements come with strategies, KPIs, timeframes, costs and lead institutions
Develops high-value dataset registers, data-sharing protocols and open-data licensing for AI
Prioritises digital sovereignty, local talent, compute infrastructure and county-level coordination
